name: io.github.dataline-xyz/dataline
title: Dataline
description: Read-only market data tools for crypto, derivatives, prediction markets, and DeFi.

environmentVariables.name: DATALINE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dataline API key for api_key mode.

environmentVariables.name: DATALINE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Development bearer token for oauth mode.

environmentVariables.name: DATALINE_X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM wallet private key for x402 mode.

environmentVariables.name: DATALINE_X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Base network in CAIP-2 format for x402 mode.

environmentVariables.name: DATALINE_X402_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Maximum x402 payment per Data API request.

environmentVariables.name: DATALINE_CONTROL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Control API origin for the pricing catalog.
